doc: Hand-derived from mm.gd and Godot 4.5.1's MultiMesh, MultiMeshInstance2D and CPUParticles2D (scene/resources/multimesh.cpp, scene/2d/cpu_particles_2d.cpp), not measured (README.md). A cell's multimesh is the hook-log rid whose last allocation has the cell's `instances` (unique per cell; CPUParticles2D's constructor allocates 8 first). `calls` are the exact counts of each hooked multimesh call per cell on every /11 leg (keys are the call names without the `multimesh_` prefix; `free` is RenderingServer::free on the multimesh), apart from teardown (a `free` or a `set_visible_instances` of 0 at or after the last transaction's frame: node and resource destructors after the quit). `per_frame` names the calls a cell makes every frame: every frame from its first such call to its last carries at least one, over at least `min_per_frame_frames` frames, and the total exceeds the number of those frames by at most `calls[name]` (the one-off calls of the same name). `headless` replaces `calls`/`per_frame` entries on the headless leg, whose host never runs frame_pre_draw (CPUParticles2D and I_PREDRAW never set a buffer there). `visible` is the ordered list of set_visible_instances values. `rejected` counts lines with accepted false: H_FREE's step-1 wrong-size set_buffer (3 floats for 2 x 8), which GLES3 refuses (drivers/gles3/storage/mesh_storage.cpp _multimesh_set_buffer); the dummy storage would store it, so the capture must judge acceptance by Godot's own size rule on both hosts. `drawn`: the cell's multimesh is named by an item from its first state line on (H_FREE until its step-2 free, then a freed tombstone until frame 41's clear, then gone); G_HIDDEN is never named. `pairing`: the buffer float that carries the fixture frame (instance 0's custom.x, at index `float` of the instance), whose value minus the transaction frame must be one constant per leg, equal to the hook log's value minus call frame (`sentinel` before the first frame).

late_arm.doc: LAR2 (late-arm-registry-design.md, the multimesh row): the `deferred` legs load the capture in the loader's _enter_tree and arm at frame `arm_frame` (GRC_ARM_DEFER_FRAMES = arm_frame - 1), so every multimesh is created under the hooks and adopted from the registry's recorded allocation at its first add_multimesh after the arm: every `drawn` cell but those with `freed_at_step` (H_FREE's raw item is withheld, never redrawn). A cell's `format` (default 2d), `colors` and `custom` are its allocation; `status`/`reason` (default ok) are what the wire carries for it, born or adopted (J_3D: a 3D-format multimesh is unsupported/multimesh-3d). `edited` cells set instance data per instance after their last buffer: on the dummy host (the headless deferred leg) those are refused, typed edited-dummy (design O3), since the dummy dropped the setters; every other adopted cell keeps its born instance count there. The `late` leg loads the capture at frame `arm_frame`, after every multimesh exists: under F1 each of those cells is refused, typed preload-multimesh.

pixels.doc: PM2 (render-stream-11.md "As built (PM2)"): the 640x360 shot is a 3x3 grid of cells (220x130, the last column and row narrower; I_PREDRAW's region starts at x 430, where its first quad reaches), one cell per fixture cell, each region inclusive [x0, y0, x1, y1]; LAR2's J_CUSTOM and J_3D are two sub-rects inside G_HIDDEN's grid cell, listed before it (a pixel counts for the first region holding it; G_HIDDEN's top-left pixel, the background sample, stays outside them; J_3D is never drawn: the 2D canvas skips a 3D-format multimesh); every multimesh draws inside its own cell and nothing is drawn outside the cells. `drawn_steps`: the checkpoints at whose settle frame the cell's multimesh draws (G_HIDDEN never: hidden; H_FREE not at step 2: freed at frame 40, its item cleared at 41). `moving`: per cell, the checkpoints at which its pixels change from the frame before (B_CUSTOM's shader reads INSTANCE_CUSTOM.x, the frame number, by parity; C_FLIP and D_GLOBAL simulate; C_FLIP is still at frame 4, measured), so step-<k>-prev.png differs from step-<k>.png there. `known_gaps`: what the receivers do not reproduce yet, with the cells it touches (none since UIT, which closed PM2's identity-transform gap). `identity_transform`: UIT's cells.

identity_transform.doc: UIT (render-stream-11.md "As built (UIT)"): D_GLOBAL is a global-coordinate CPUParticles2D (local_coords false), so its item made canvas_item_set_use_identity_transform(true): its buffer holds global particle transforms and the item draws with the canvas transform alone, while its children keep the composed transform. The cell also draws a rect on that item in global coordinates (170, 203, 12x12) and one on a child Node2D of it (local (100, 45), 10x10, moving with the parent). A receiver that ignores the flag (receiver sabotage ignore-identity-transform, the pre-UIT receiver) draws the item through its moving parent a second time: its particles land down and right, partly in G_HIDDEN's cell (`spill`), and its rect off screen; the child rect stays where it is.
